name: Blood Moon Rising
source:
You hold a secret in your blood that can change the fate of a world you never knew existed. Want to change things for the better? Seduce an alpha to gain their protection and help.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你的血液里藏着一个秘密，足以改变一个世界的命运，而你原先甚至不知道那个世界存在。想让事情变得好一些吗？那就让一名Alpha为你倾心，争取对方的保护和帮助。

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]］
